# Blink

**Category:** Player  
**Aliases:** Blink

## What it does

Blink holds your packets instead of sending them, making your character freeze in place on the server while you keep moving freely on your own screen. The moment the held packets are released, all your movement is replayed at once, so to everyone else it looks like you suddenly teleported across the world to wherever you've actually walked. By default it only delays your outgoing packets, but it can also suspend incoming ones.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/player/blink). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
